crossRefs.note: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was…
They burned the city with fire, and all that was in it. Only they put the silver, the gold, and the vessels of bronze…
In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up…
However, the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaved.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

translations.web: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”
translations.bsb: When someone came and told David about his men, he sent messengers to meet them, since the men had been thoroughly humiliated. The king told them, “Stay in Jericho until your beards have grown back, and then return.”
translations.kjv: Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
translations.asv: Then there went certain persons, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them; for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
